_doc: The private team page's regression rule, copied for scripts/regression_watch.py (docs/dashboard-autopilot-v1.md section 8): the constants of litert-bench-dashboard build.py at its commit 8100b64 (the page built from the bench at e3010721), read out of that module, not retyped. Each key names its source line in build.py: subject = SUBJECT (l.199); subject_arms = the arms RUNTIME (l.191-197, l.217, l.231) maps to the subject (build_regression keeps RUNTIME[arm] == SUBJECT only, l.1265); devices = REGRESSION_DEVICES (l.350) with each device's platform from PANELS (l.159-165); models = REGRESSION_MODELS (l.352, model row labels, render_dashboard.model_row); tasks = REGRESSION_TASKS (l.353, NATIVE_TASK l.81); metrics = REGRESSION_METRICS (l.354) with the better direction of METRICS (l.311-316; diff_pct l.812 turns a lower-is-better value into a rate); cell_files = CELL_FILES (l.104-124, l.134-135, l.142-143) in order, [file, task, only]: each file read for that task only, only = the device identifiers the file is for (null = every device of its platform), the first definition of a (platform, arm, model id, task, context, file) key winning (load_cell_defs l.400); optional_cell_files = OPTIONAL_CELL_FILES (l.126-128, l.136, l.144: a missing one is skipped, another missing file is an error); backend = BACKEND (l.254-306), the subject arms' column, keyed '<platform> <arm>'; stand_in = STAND_IN (l.177-180), a lab unit's device string -> the panel phone it stands in for (stand_in_rows l.384 re-keys its accelerator rows and drops the rest; build_regression skips every stand-in row, l.1254); page_campaigns_contain = the weekly-sittings filter of load_rows (l.366-381, campaign dir names containing 'dashboard'). Not copied, because the bench is their source: the threshold (render_leaderboard.SPREAD_FLAG, which build.py imports), the aggregation (render_leaderboard.arm_row, latest_session), the regime (render_dashboard.headline_regime), exclusions (render_dashboard.exclusion with the schedule.json keys of device_keys) and model_row. Restated in scripts/regression_watch.py, with their lines: headline (l.517), NO_NUMBER and headline_status (l.533-555), regression_value (l.1232), diff_pct (l.812), build_regression (l.1239-1359). When build.py changes these, this file and that code change with it; regression_watch.py --compare <page>/dist/regression.json (and the post step's red segment, every night) says when they disagree.
